dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You're not bad with that wind glider. Your gliding style seems familiar...

choices.text: How'd you get your eye patch?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: My eye patch? Wanna hear my story, eh?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I didn't have time to introduce myself properly... Well, it wasn't on my mind to begin with.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Ehe... My apologies. I'm Kaeya, Cavalry Captain for the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: We can talk more after we get things sorted.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I know a great place more fit for a chat.

choices.text: Why is Jean the Acting Grand Master?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The Grand Master is currently off leading an expedition, so the Master, Jean, has stepped in to oversee the Knights while he's gone.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hence, you'll hear many refer to her as the Acting Grand Master.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: When the Grand Master left, he took the vast majority of our knights with him, leaving the Acting Grand Master with far more responsibility and stress.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Come to think of it, it must have been difficult for Jean.
